test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct idiom that can substitute the italicised group of words in the given sentence.**

You must not participate in the marathon this year without any training. It is *an unreal hope* on your part!
solution: The correct answer is: "**a pipe dream**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom "**a pipe dream**" means an unrealistic hope or fantasy. (एक अवास्तविक आशा या कल्पना) • **Example**: *Investing all his money in a get-rich-quick scheme turned out to be a pipe dream.* • It is used to describe something that is unlikely to happen or achieve. • The phrase originated from the idea of smoking opium, which creates dream-like hallucinations. • In the given sentence, the speaker is telling someone not to participate in a marathon without any training, as it is an unrealistic hope. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • "**Carrying coal to new castle**" means doing something pointless or unnecessary, as Newcastle is a coal mining town. (कोई निरर्थक या अनावश्यक कार्य करना) • "**A will-o'-the-wisp**" means something that is difficult to find or achieve, like a fairy-like light that appears and disappears. (खोजना या हासिल करना कठिन है) • "**To lose one's temper**" means to become angry or upset. (क्रोधित या परेशान होना) 156:T5df, The correct answer is: **DBCA**
